meta.name: healthcheck
meta.description: Host security hardening and risk-tolerance configuration for Velaclaw deployments. Use when a user asks for security audits, firewall/SSH/update hardening, risk posture, exposure review, Velaclaw cron scheduling for periodic checks, or version status checks on a machine running Velaclaw (laptop, workstation, Pi, VPS).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加固主机安全并配置风险容忍度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Velaclaw 机器上做安全加固和风险检查
copy.tagline_en: Harden host security and configure risk tolerance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to harden security and check risk on a Velaclaw machine

howto.what: Claude会检查运行Velaclaw的主机安全，包括系统信息、防火墙、SSH、更新等，运行Velaclaw安全审计，确定风险容忍度，生成修复计划，并可帮您执行或定时检查。
howto.when: 当您询问安全审计、防火墙/SSH/更新加固、风险态势、暴露审查、Velaclaw版本状态，或要求设置定期检查时触发。

say.text: 检查这台Velaclaw主机的安全状态。
say.note: 开始读权限检查和Velaclaw审计。

say.text: 帮我加固这台机器，采用家庭/工作站平衡模式。
给Velaclaw设置每周安全审计的定时任务。

howto.what_en: Claude assesses and hardens the host running Velaclaw, gathering OS info, firewall/SSH/update status, running Velaclaw security audits, determining risk tolerance, generating a remediation plan, and optionally executing steps or scheduling periodic checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about security audits, firewall/SSH/update hardening, risk posture, exposure review, Velaclaw version status, or scheduling periodic checks.

say_en.text: Check the security status of this Velaclaw host.
say_en.note: Starts read-only checks and Velaclaw audit.

say_en.text: Harden this machine using the home/workstation balanced profile.
say_en.note: Generates and executes a hardening plan.

say_en.text: Schedule a weekly security audit for Velaclaw.
say_en.note: Sets up cron for periodic audits.
